description: Provide products (URLs or ASINs) and/or discovery inputs (keyword terms, search URLs, bestseller lists). Locale, currency, delivery ZIP, and search filters are optional.

asins.description: Bare 10-character Amazon ASINs. Builds /dp/{ASIN} URLs on the selected marketplace, or on every domain listed in `domains` for cross-marketplace runs.
asins.title: ASINs

bestsellerUrls.description: Amazon bestseller /zgbs/ or /gp/bestsellers/ list URLs. Returns the ranked product cards, optionally enriched with product-detail fields.
bestsellerUrls.title: Bestseller List URLs

brand.description: Optional brand word added to keyword search terms and used as a title/brand post-filter. This is not a structured Amazon brand-facet resolver.
brand.title: Brand / Keyword Refinement

condition.description: Item condition filter for keyword searches. `new` is live-validated; other values are best effort.
condition.title: Condition

currency.description: ISO currency for the displayed price. `auto` uses the marketplace currency. Note: Amazon converts display currency; it is not guaranteed local retail pricing.
currency.title: Display Currency

dealsOnly.description: Apply Amazon's deals filter to keyword searches. Only affects discovery.
dealsOnly.title: Deals Only

deliveryCountry.description: Optional country hint. When `postalCode` is empty, a representative local ZIP for that country is used. A country alone is not sent to Amazon.
deliveryCountry.title: Delivery Country

domains.description: Optional list of marketplaces (e.g. amazon.com, amazon.de) to run bare ASINs and search terms across. Leave empty to use `marketplace` only.
domains.title: Additional Domains

failOnEmpty.description: Mark the run as FAILED when no product/search records are emitted.
failOnEmpty.title: Fail on Empty

includeDetails.description: Fetch each discovery result's product page for full price, seller, variants, specs, reviews, and media fields. Disable for a cheaper search-card-only run.
includeDetails.title: Fetch Product Details

includeFailed.description: Emit an error row (recordType=error, reason, httpStatus) when a product or discovery input fails instead of silently dropping it.
includeFailed.title: Include Failure Rows

includeSponsored.description: Keep sponsored search cards. The isSponsored flag is always preserved.
includeSponsored.title: Include Sponsored Results

includeTopReviews.description: Include the inline top-review snippets Amazon renders publicly. Full review pagination is login-gated and is not supported.
includeTopReviews.title: Include Top Reviews

includeVariants.description: Include parent ASIN, child ASINs, and variant dimensions. Per-variant price and stock are not available from the product page.
includeVariants.title: Include Variants

language.description: Page language. `auto` uses the marketplace's own default. Explicit values set `?language=` and the matching Accept-Language header.
language.title: Language

marketplace.description: Marketplace used for bare ASINs and keyword search terms. `auto` uses the first product URL's domain, or amazon.com.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

maxItems.description: Maximum number of search/bestseller rows across all discovery inputs. Explicit product URLs/ASINs are always processed.
maxItems.title: Max Discovery Items

maxPages.description: Maximum search-result pages to read per keyword or search URL (1-20).
maxPages.title: Max Pages per Query

maxPrice.description: Maximum price for discovery (search) results. Leave empty for no upper bound.
maxPrice.title: Maximum Price

minPrice.description: Minimum price for discovery (search) results. Leave empty for no lower bound.
minPrice.title: Minimum Price

minRating.description: Minimum star rating for discovery results. `4` is the live-validated 4+ stars filter; lower values are best effort.
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

postalCode.description: Local ZIP/postal code for the delivery location. The actor validates it against the marketplace format and skips the location change if it does not match.
postalCode.title: Postal Code

primeOnly.description: Apply Amazon's Prime filter to keyword searches. Prime eligibility itself is not emitted because the page does not expose a reliable per-item signal.
primeOnly.title: Prime Only

productUrls.description: Amazon product URLs to scrape. Any mix of the 21 supported country domains is allowed, e.g. https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0B8PD8TTP.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor starts direct and escalates through Apify Proxy automatically only if Amazon blocks the request. No setup is required.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

proxyCountry.description: Optional proxy exit country. `AUTO` uses the marketplace's own country for every domain.
proxyCountry.title: Proxy Country

rateLimitDelay.description: Base pause in seconds between product/search requests (0-10). A random value between this and twice this is used.
rateLimitDelay.title: Delay Between Requests

searchTerms.description: Keyword queries to run on Amazon search pages. Price/rating/deal/condition/sort filters are applied as URL parameters.
searchTerms.title: Search Terms

searchUrls.description: Full Amazon search URLs to pass through, including your own `i=`, `rh=`, `low-price`, and `s=` parameters. Pagination is added automatically.
searchUrls.title: Search URLs

sortBy.description: Sort order for keyword searches. Search-URL pass-through keeps its own sort.
sortBy.title: Sort By

stock.description: Best-effort stock filter applied after parsing. Records with unknown stock pass through.
stock.title: Stock

title: Amazon Multi-Domain Product Price & Detail Scraper Input
